content.playerFantasy: A ROBLOX roleplay life avatar experience built around roleplay and avatar while using its own world, visual identity, progression, economy, content, and interaction design.
coreLoop: Enter a shared social space, choose an avatar identity or role, and pick a short activity, location, or interaction goal with other players.
Perform roleplay activities, jobs, collection, customization, or social interactions that produce visible rewards and identity feedback.
Use rewards to expand avatar, home, vehicle, or social expression options, then choose a new roleplay goal or group activity in the same persistent world.
